profile.headline: Freelance Programmer & Business Management
profile.summary:
As a Freelance Software Engineer, I specialize in designing scalable black-box systems and optimizing complex data solutions to deliver clean, performant code. My expertise spans large-scale systems architecture, code refactoring, and performance optimization. Throughout my time freelancing I've collaborated with Adult Swim, Discord, Humble Bundle, & Chemex Coffee on various different projects - with budgets ranging from $10K - $10M.

When not working professionally, you can find me creating content under my personal brand "GentooGames", where I cultivate a small community encouraging aspiring game developers across social platforms: Twitch, YouTube, and Discord.

positions.title: Game Developer & Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Created software products for high-profile clients: "Adult Swim", "Discord", "Humble Bundle", "Outersloth", and "Chemex Coffee" with operating budgets up to $10M
● Delivered scalable applications from prototype phase to production release in a fast-paced, specialized environment.
● Developed custom tools, systems, and developer pipelines to support content delivery in 10+ languages for international customers in multiple countries.
● Built and optimized real-time architectures, including server/client synchronization, RESTful middleware, and netcode implementations, supporting high-traffic live-service applications.
● Refactored core architectural systems using OOP principles and design patterns to enhance code quality, stability, and general performance.
● Architected complex data-solutions, and integrated native save/load pipelines for local hardware serialization in addition to cloud data synchronizations.
● Developed code using a "Free-To-Play" live service model; delivering new features, bug fixes, & code improvements shipped to thousands of monthly active users.
● Directed agile workflows using tools such as GitLab, GitHub, Linear, Trello, and Notion.
● Managed cloud infrastructure using Google Cloud and Kubernetes for monitoring, debugging, and deploying dedicated servers, ensuring seamless integration and scalability.
● Created technical prototypes, mockups, documentation, flowcharts, and onboarding materials to accelerate team collaboration and knowledge transfer in a distributed setting.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
● Maintained and developed a full stack web application using Java, Weblogic, Maven, SQL Developer, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, XML, Jenkins, and TFS technologies.
● Fulfilled user stories and coordinated with the internal testing departments to meet specific business requirements in an Agile/Scrum workflow.
● Optimized and improved application by implementing multi-threading methodologies and RESTful web APIs.
● Implemented Java solutions to automate developer database work and minimize redundancy.

positions.title: Front-End Web Development Intern
positions.description:
● Learned basic front end fundamentals such as CSS and HTML while simultaneously using Wordpress to maintain backend systems.
● Shadowed senior developers and worked with clients to create desktop and mobile applications with PHP, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
● Lead testing and debugging of desktop and mobile sites for bug management and reporting.

projects.title: LD43 Game Dev Competition
projects.description: For the Ludum Dare 43 Game Development Competition I worked solo to develop a game from scratch in 72 hours, and for this theme, Sacrifices Must Be Made, I created a multiplayer party game about trying to sacrifice more prisoners than your opponents. This game utilizes a fully integrated physics system, a pseudo-intelligent AI system, and multiplayer/gamepad support. After completion, I had several large members of the game dev streaming community play the game on their social media platforms, where it was met with great responses and positive feedback. The game was rated among the top 20% of all 2500+ games that were entered, for the competition, in every category.

projects.title: LD42 Game Dev Competition
projects.description: For the Ludum Dare 42 Game Development Competition I worked solo to develop a game from scratch in 72 hours, and for this theme, Running Out Of Space, I created a game about running around, and trying to take care of 100 Dogs. This game utilizes procedural map generation, a fully integrated physics system, and a pseudo-intelligent AI system. After completion, I had several large members of the game dev streaming community play the game on their social media platforms, where it was met with great responses and positive feedback. The game was rated in the top 10% of all 3000+ games that were entered for the competition in nearly every category.

organizations.name: Arizona State University eSport Association
organizations.description: Weekly meetings and monthly events where I was responsible for documenting and recording while also managing social media sites.

organizations.name: StringPlay Summer Camp
organizations.description:
StringPlay is a Summer Camp designed to teach Junior High and High School orchestra students how to break the stereotypes of classical music. As a member of the teaching staff, I am responsible for working with not only large groups of 30+ students at a time, but also working in small groups teaching and coordinating so that students walk away from the two week camp with a better knowledge of how to play music and think about music in a new and innovative way. 
In addition, I also worked on several promotional projects where I planned and executed a promotional video that highlighted the summer camp and is used on our camp website.
